净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Value signals (book yield) are conditioned on size by applying a quality filter (positive ROE) only for stocks in a time-series small-cap regime (current float market cap below its 1-year rolling median). This avoids amplifying distressed small-cap value traps while preserving the cheapness signal for large caps. The mechanism uses size as a conditional gate, not a monotonic multiplier.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

PB_cheapness = 1 / pb_lf; if mkt_cap_float < ts_median(252, mkt_cap_float) AND roe_ttm2 <= 0 then nan else PB_cheapness
依赖列: pb_lf, roe_ttm2, mkt_cap_float

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

PB_cheapness = 1 / pb_lf; if mkt_cap_float < ts_median(252, mkt_cap_float) AND roe_ttm2 <= 0 then nan else PB_cheapness
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：divide(1, pb_lf) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 cheapness：1.0 / pb_lf
  2. 计算 size_median：mkt_cap_float.滚动窗口(252, min_periods=63).median()
  3. 计算 is_small：mkt_cap_float < size_median
  4. 计算 positive_roe：roe_ttm2 > 0

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_value_small_size_quality_filter(df): df_copy = df.copy() "com"># Book yield cheapness cheapness = 1.0 / df_copy["pb_lf"].replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Time-series size regime: rolling median of mkt_cap_float (1 year window) size_median = df_copy["mkt_cap_float"].rolling(252, min_periods=63).median() "com"># Flag small: current mkt_cap_float below rolling median is_small = df_copy["mkt_cap_float"] < size_median "com"># Quality filter: positive ROE positive_roe = df_copy["roe_ttm2"] > 0 "com"># For small caps, use cheapness only "kw">class="kw">if ROE positive; "kw">class="kw">for large caps, use cheapness as is df_copy["factor_value_small_size_quality_filter"] = np.where( is_small & ~positive_roe, np.nan, cheapness ) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_value_small_size_quality_filter"]
